name: text-adventure-engine
description: Modular, deterministic text adventure foundation for Web and AI-assisted authoring

scripts.check:example: node tools/authoring/check-route.mjs --story examples/minimal/story.json --route examples/minimal/route-count.json --out build/routes/count.json && node tools/authoring/check-route.mjs --story examples/minimal/story.json --route examples/minimal/route-skip.json --out build/routes/skip.json
scripts.example:markdown: node tools/authoring/compile-markdown.mjs --config examples/minimal-markdown/compiler.json && node packages/cli/bin/story.mjs validate build/minimal-markdown/story.json
